model_application.note: None of the 9 modeled ports lies inside the Persian Gulf; Hormuz is applied as a global fuel/war-risk multiplier + standalone scenario, NOT per-port delay. Suez/Red Sea crisis (SCA -50% transits) remains the per-port conflict driver for Suez/Port Said.
